title: [Bug]: triton/pipeline_client: RuntimeError: no running event loop
author: abysshal

comments.author: junjiejiangjjj
comments.body:
hi @abysshal , before using triton_client, create an event loop by this code
```python
 try:
        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
    except:
        loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
        asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)

comments.author: abysshal
comments.body:
> hi @abysshal , before using triton_client, create an event loop by this code
> 
> ```python
>  try:
>         loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
>     except:
>         loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
>         asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
> ```

感谢回复，我简单快速的测试了一下，仍旧是报相同的错误，测试代码如下：
```
from towhee import triton_client
import asyncio

try:
    loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
except:
    print('failed to get_event_loop()')
    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
    asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)

print(loop)
client = triton_client.Client(url='127.0.0.1:8010')
res = client('dog')
print(res)
```

但是你的回复让我了解到仅靠文档里展示的几行示例代码可能是无法直接搞定的，我会学习`asyncio`库，添加更多的上下文环境，尝试搞定 调用tritronserver 推理的这个例子的。

comments.author: junjiejiangjjj
comments.body: Check if the version of this dependent library is correct： aiohttp==3.9.5

comments.author: abysshal
comments.body:
> Check if the version of this dependent library is correct： aiohttp==3.9.5

原来默认安装的是 aiohttp==3.11.9版本，当重新安装 3.9.5 版本后，问题解决了。甚至只要三行也能运行了：
```
from towhee import triton_client
client = triton_client.Client(url='127.0.0.1:8000')
res = client(text_to_search)
```
